 Gaurav Parihar

High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Amitesh Sonkar - advocate for the applicant.

Ms. Seema Jaiswal-P.L. for the respondent/State.
 Shri Varun Pratap Singh Parihar - advocate for the obj  ORDER

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS (Section 439 of the Cr.P.C.).
2.

The applicant is in custody since 27.11.2024 in connection with Crime No.307/2024 registered at P.S.-State Cyber Cell, District-Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420,
120(B) of IPC and Section 66(D) of Information and Technology Act, 2000.
3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant arranged bank account through co-accused Komal and for that applicant gave Rs. 6,000/- to co-accused Komal.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
Nothing has been recovered from applicant.
Applicant is in jail since 27.11.2024.
There is no evidence to connect the applicant with the offence.
He further submits that the trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the objector has no objection if applicant is released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
7. In view of over all facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

8. It is directed that applicant-Gaurav Parihar be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
9. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
10. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
